title: refactor(types,plugin-calendar,plugin-gantt,plugin-list,plugin-view)!: flat object-calendar / object-gantt keys leave the published schemas; producers emit the block
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBVVaEbKjJHqT747bQHd6Uxp)_

Part of #25923 (work item 1 only; items 3, 4 and the FormField follow-up stay on the card).

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md` already authors the `gantt` block and no skill authors a flat `object-calendar` or `object-gantt` key; the two plugin READMEs are corrected here

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`@object-ui/types` 里 `object-calendar` 和 `object-gantt` 节点不再公开“平铺”的字段映射键（如 `startDateField`），这些键只能写在 `calendar` / `gantt` 块里；`ListView` 和 `ObjectView` 生成节点时也改为写块。
- 为什么改：spec 本来就拒绝这些平铺写法，但我们的类型还公开着它们，`objectui validate` 因此放行了日历节点上 spec 拒绝的写法，作者会被误导。
- 风险与回滚：渲染器仍读平铺写法，已有页面照常显示；唯一例外是早于写入校验的存量视图，若其 `options.gantt` 带有 spec 拒绝的值，现在显示甘特拒绝屏而不是照常绘制（数量未测，由卡片第 3 项的存量行盘点来数）。另一风险在于手写 TS 代码里写了平铺键的会编译失败（按 changeset 里的迁移改成块即可）。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`（calendar / gantt 两个分支的出块条件）、`ui/packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`（被删的成员）、`ui/packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx`（`ObjectGanttFlatFields`）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.gantt-binding-7070.test.tsx packages/types/src/__tests__/gantt-flat-config-declared-keys.test.ts`，预期全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The flat field-mapping keys of `object-calendar` and `object-gantt` leave the published `@object-ui/types` faces (TypeScript interface and tolerant zod mirror) and move to package-local hand-off types next to their one reader (ui/AGENTS.md Commandment #0.1). The producers emit the block.

**Moved off the published faces**

- `ObjectCalendarSchema`: `startDateField`, `endDateField`, `titleField`, `colorField`, `allDayField` (5). New home: `ObjectCalendarFlatFields` / `ObjectCalendarHandoff` in `plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx`.
- `ObjectGanttSchema`: the 29 `GanttConfig` keys (`startDateField`, `endDateField`, `titleField`, `progressField`, `dependenciesField`, `colorField`, `borderColorField`, `parentField`, `typeField`, `lockField`, `objectField`, `summaryExtent`, `defaultCollapsedDepth`, `tooltipFields`, `baselineStartField`, `baselineEndField`, `groupByField`, `resourceView`, `assigneeField`, `effortField`, `capacity`, `quickFilters`, `autoZoomToFilter`, `timeSegments`, `interactions`, `exportFileName`, `timeZone`, `dependencyTypes`, `viewMode`), plus the legacy `dependencyField` alias and the `search` / `searchableFields` pair only `ListView`'s toolbar writes (32). New home: `ObjectGanttFlatFields` (derived from `GanttConfig`, so the two spellings cannot fork) / `ObjectGanttHandoff` in `plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx`.

**Kept**

- `ObjectCalendarSchema`: the `calendar` block, the `dateField` / `endField` aliasKeyRefusal tombstones, and every other node key.
- `ObjectGanttSchema`: `gantt`, `staticData`, `filter`, `sort`, and every other node key.
- Seat 2's ruling 6412606977 (the `FormField` index signature) is not touched.

**For gantt, the strict authoring face already refused every flat key** (its `object-gantt` arm is the `properties` bag, `ObjectGanttBlockSchema`, objectui#10859), so the narrowing there is the published TypeScript and zod export only. For calendar the strict face derived from the declared keys and accepted the five flat; it now refuses them by name, as the spec does.

**Producers.** `ListView` (calendar and gantt branches) and `ObjectView`'s `generateViewSchema` (calendar and gantt cases) emit `calendar: {…}` / `gantt: {…}` instead of the flat keys. They emit the block only where the renderer's flat branch drew, so what a view shows is unchanged, with the one exception under Acceptance notes: a calendar once `startDateField` is declared; a gantt once both dates are, with `titleField` floored at `'name'` as the flat branch floored it.

**Renderers are unchanged.** `getCalendarConfig` and `getGanttConfig` still read the block first and fall back to the flat spelling, now typed on the hand-off type. READMEs of both plugins are corrected (they said the producers emit the flat spelling), and so are the explanatory clauses of the two `@objectstack/spec` prescriptions that said the same (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, rework r3).

## Tests

- `@object-ui/types`: the pins that declared the flat keys now pin their absence on both published faces and the strict-face refusal (`calendar-flat-color-allday-8466`, `gantt-flat-config-declared-keys`, `gantt-dependency-field-deprecated-alias`, `gantt-search-keys-10250`, `gantt-view-mode-declared` re-pointed to `gantt.viewMode`, `object-gantt-properties-bag-10859-b6`, `calendar-date-alias-refusal-8355`).
- `plugin-calendar`: `calendarUnionReads-8651` pins `ObjectCalendarComponentProps['schema']` as `ObjectCalendarHandoff` and the hand-off key census.
- `plugin-gantt`: new `ganttHandoffFlatFields-25923` pins the hand-off as exactly `GanttConfig`'s keys plus the three, no overlap with the published interface, the renderer prop typed with it, and the alias's `@deprecated` tag.
- `plugin-list` / `plugin-view`: the producer tests read the emitted block and red on any flat key coming back; new rows pin "no block without the axis" and the `'name'` floor.
- Reverse check: re-adding `colorField` to `ObjectGanttSchema` and `startDateField` to `ObjectCalendarSchema` reds `calendar-flat-color-allday-8466.test.ts(182)`, `gantt-flat-config-declared-keys.test.ts(316)` and `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts(4474)` under `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, each naming the key or schema.

## Acceptance notes

- **Follow-up candidate (not filed):** retire the flat fallback read in `getCalendarConfig` / `getGanttConfig` and the hand-off types with it. No producer in this tree writes the flat spelling any more; about 80 renderer tests still author flat nodes and would move to the block.
- The tolerant mirror no longer value-checks the moved keys written flat (`ObjectGanttSchema.safeParse({ …, colorField: 5 })` now passes `.passthrough()`), which is why the declaration reads `yes (narrowing)` rather than the order's `no (narrowing)`. The strict face and the spec still refuse them; the value check lives in the block (`gantt.capacity: 'one'` is refused at `gantt.capacity`).
- **Reading (measured in rework r1; the r1 deviation was withdrawn in r2, Prime Directive #12):** `getGanttConfig` parses a `gantt` block against the spec's `GanttConfigSchema` (objectui#13459) and never validated the flat branch. app-shell relays a stored row's `options.gantt` unvalidated (`storedLegacyOptions`). So under main's write door, a pre-door stored row whose `options.gantt` carries a spec-refused value (e.g. `viewMode: 'hour'`) now lands on `gantt-invalid-config` instead of drawing. The producers emit the block unconditionally and never a flat key; such a row is converted at the store (ADR-0087), not tolerated at a consumer. The population is unmeasured; work item 3 (the stored-row census) on the card is where it gets counted. The prose in `ListView.tsx`, plugin-view `ObjectView.tsx`, `ObjectGantt.tsx` and the changeset (including its ADR-0087 marker, which used to say "nothing that drew before stops drawing") says this.
- The object-calendar `dateField` / `endField` tombstones now prescribe `calendar.startDateField` / `calendar.endDateField` (rework r1; this round made the old prescription false). Pinned in `calendar-date-alias-refusal-8355` and `calendarUnionReads-8651`, with a control that the bare canonical is never prescribed.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` is not touched.
- **`@objectstack/spec` prescription prose (rework r3):** the explanatory clauses of `OBJECT_CALENDAR_FLAT_FIELD_GUIDANCE` and `OBJECT_GANTT_FLAT_CONFIG_GUIDANCE` in `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` said `ObjectView` / `ListView` emit, or flatten into, the flat spelling. This PR made that false. They now say the producers hand the binding off in the `calendar` / `gantt` block, and that the flat spelling is only a stored-document fallback the renderer still reads, not authorable. Nothing else in the prescriptions changes, including the "Write this as a key of the … config object instead" sentence. The changeset now carries `'@objectstack/spec': minor`. The grade is minor because `check-changeset-no-major` grades only the root workspace and the narrowing lives in the ui workspace (`@object-ui/types`), while the spec diff itself is prescription prose. Before editing, I searched for the old wording and found it nowhere else in `packages/spec` tests, `json-schema/`, `content/docs/` or `sdui.manifest.json` (only in historical CHANGELOGs), so nothing needed regenerating. Rework r4 also rewrote the JSDoc around those two guidance sets, plus the docblock of the object-gantt props schema. It used to say the producers "emit on their runtime handoff", "EMIT when they flatten `options.gantt`", call the flat branch the "HOT path", say that `ObjectGanttSchema` "declares the whole flat face", and call the flat keys "the flatten product". It now says the producers hand off the block, the flat spelling is a stored-document fallback, and the flat keys live on the package-local hand-off types. A sweep of this PR's ui files fixed six more comments of the same kind: `ObjectCalendar.tsx`, `ObjectGantt.tsx`, `objectql.ts`, `objectql.zod.ts`, `calendar-flat-color-allday-8466` and `object-gantt-properties-bag-10859-b6`. These are comments only; no string, key, example or accept set moved.
